video_title: Postgame Media Availability with Coach Daigneault, Ajay, and Shai | OKC Thunder | October 28, 2026

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on defensive adjustments against Dallas
quotes.excerpt: we kept them out of the deep paint on a lot of those and he made us pay
quotes.quote: We will have to watch it, but I thought a lot of credit to Flag with some of the shot-making. I thought we kept them out of the deep paint on a lot of those and he made us pay regardless. And then Irving stabilized them early with some scoring and then he really moved the ball and got the ball ahead of us out of the coverages. Those guys played really well tonight, so Tipper had to them. There is things that we can do better, but there is another part of it which is those guys rose up and made some plays.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the defensive effort against Dallas: We kept them out of the deep paint on a lot of those, but they made us pay regardless. Those guys rose up and made some plays.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault discusses the defensive challenges posed by Kyrie Irving and the Dallas Mavericks during the postgame press conference.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Jalen Williams and Josh Giddey's defensive development
quotes.excerpt: we get a lot of new guys playing right now and we have got guys playing different roles
quotes.quote: We get a lot of new guys playing right now and we have got guys playing different roles that you are referencing, which we have to invest in. We will get better at it. They will improve as they get those reps. It is good for them. It kind of broadens their game, and it is good for us. There is a lot of stuff we can improve at, and I also thought on a night that it was not our night, we gave ourselves some chances and then the game got away from us a little bit.
quotes.social_post: Daigneault on the Thunder rotation: We have a lot of new guys playing right now and guys in different roles. We have to invest in it. They will improve as they get those reps.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault discusses the defensive development and role changes for Jalen Williams and Josh Giddey.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault praises Ajay's consistent work ethic
quotes.excerpt: he has been the same guy from the minute he got on the ground
quotes.quote: He has been the same guy from the minute he got on the ground. He has been a great worker. He has been a very consistent and stable personality. He just keeps his head down and does whatever it is that the team needs to help us win. That has been his mentality from when he was a rookie until obviously he is grown quickly in the NBA, and he has had the same mentality. It has not changed in one bit, so he has played great. He controlled the game again tonight when the ball was in his hands and is off to a great start obviously.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Ajay: He has been the same guy from the minute he got on the ground. He has been a great worker and a very consistent and stable personality.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault praises the consistent work ethic and personality of Ajay.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.excerpt: I thought it was his best complete game so far of the young season
quotes.quote: I thought it was his best complete game so far of the young season, including preseason. He is just going to get better with the reps as he figures out the NBA game, same with the dye, same with Josh, all those guys. You have got to learn the speed of the game, you have got to learn the league. There is a lot coming at you at once, but that is where experience helps, so they are going to get those experiences and they have got the right approach and mindset that will help them grow through them.
quotes.social_post: Daigneault calls tonight Ajay's best complete game of the young season: He is just going to get better with the reps as he figures out the NBA game.

structured.context: Mark Daigneault evaluates the performance of Ajay and other young players while emphasizing the importance of gaining experience.

quotes.speaker: Ajay
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay on team defensive struggles against Dallas
quotes.excerpt: I think we didn't do a great job defensively throughout the whole game
quotes.quote: I think Dallas, they shot great. I think we did not do a great job defensively throughout the whole game, and I think that is something we can fix. So, it is just getting back to work, watching film, and seeing where we can be better. But you know, it is one game, we have to move on and be ready for the next one.
quotes.social_post: Ajay on the defensive struggles against Dallas: I think we did not do a great job defensively throughout the whole game. It is just getting back to work, watching film, and seeing where we can be better.

structured.context: Ajay reacts to the team's defensive performance against the Dallas Mavericks.

quotes.speaker: Ajay
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay on his aggressive offensive approach
quotes.excerpt: for me trying to create for myself and others, obviously being aggressive, trying to attack
quotes.quote: For me trying to create for myself and others, obviously being aggressive, trying to attack, getting into the paint and trying to find guys, find shots for myself. So I think it is something I have to keep doing and keep getting better at.
quotes.social_post: Ajay on his offensive mindset: For me trying to create for myself and others, obviously being aggressive, trying to attack, getting into the paint and trying to find guys.

structured.context: Ajay describes his offensive mindset and his goal to be more aggressive in creating plays.

quotes.speaker: Ajay
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay on team leadership and support
quotes.excerpt: they are a big part of our team, so it is great just to have them around
quotes.quote: They are a big part of our team, so it is great just to have them around, hear from them, and they have great spirit. And I think that helps all of us, you know, to just go out there and compete at the highest level, so it is great.
quotes.social_post: Ajay on team leadership: They are a big part of our team, so it is great just to have them around, hear from them, and they have great spirit.

structured.context: Ajay discusses the positive impact of teammates' support and spirit on the team's competitiveness.

quotes.speaker: Ajay
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay on Cason's positive attitude during injury
quotes.excerpt: he is always smiling, he is always cracking jokes, he is just he is always happy
quotes.quote: He is always smiling, he is always cracking jokes, he is just he is always happy, you know, and it is great to see that. Obviously, he is going through that injury, it is never easy for players, but he has been handling it well and it is just great to see that his spirits are high even though he is down right now. And I think it helps the whole team to just stay positive no matter what is going on.
quotes.social_post: Ajay on Cason Wallace's injury recovery: He is always smiling, he is always cracking jokes. It is great to see that his spirits are high even though he is down right now.

structured.context: Ajay discusses how Cason Wallace maintains a positive attitude while dealing with an injury.

quotes.speaker: Ajay
quotes.summary_phrase: Ajay on the benefits of extended minutes for rookies
quotes.excerpt: it is like these are great reps, obviously we are trying to win every game
quotes.quote: I was in that case my rookie year, getting more minutes early on, and so I think it is great for them. You know, it is like these are great reps, obviously we are trying to win every game, and I think they really buy into that and they are trying to get better every day. And I think for them, it is a great opportunity to be able to play that many minutes and just be able to compete.
quotes.social_post: Ajay on the value of rookie minutes: I was in that case my rookie year, getting more minutes early on, and so I think it is great for them. These are great reps.

structured.context: Ajay reflects on the benefits of rookies receiving extended playing time early in their careers.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on rebounding and defensive toughness
quotes.excerpt: we got to be better on the glass, obviously smaller out there now
quotes.quote: We got to be better on the glass. Obviously smaller out there now, so it is a little bit more challenging, but we got to be tougher, fighting more. That helps with like the second-chance points and stuff like that, and it also allows us to get out there and like play faster. And then like especially with guys down, I got to be better if we want to have a chance to win games.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the Thunder's rebounding: We got to be better on the glass. Obviously smaller out there now, so it is a little bit more challenging, but we got to be tougher, fighting more.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander discusses the need for improved rebounding and toughness due to the team's current lineup.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: he is relentless, he gets there, he takes hits all night
quotes.quote: Like you said, he is relentless. He gets there, he is there all night, he takes hits all night. He is really good in those situations, has great feel, touch, makes the next play. We seen it all last year, Ajay is a big-time basketball player in this league and will be for a long time.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Ajay: He is relentless. He is a big-time basketball player in this league and will be for a long time.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander praises the relentless play and development of his teammate Ajay.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Kyrie Irving's return
quotes.excerpt: it is great to have a guy like that back, obviously a really talented basketball player
quotes.quote: It is great to have a guy like that back, obviously a really talented basketball player. The more more guys we have like that out there, the better the game is and better it is. But ultimately, like just for guys that get the game taken away like that, unfortunately through injury, it sucks. And for them to have that piece back, that happiness back is is above all.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Kyrie Irving's return: It is great to have a guy like that back. For them to have that piece back, that happiness back is above all.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander comments on the return of Kyrie Irving and the impact of injuries on players.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the team's physical and emotional toll
quotes.excerpt: it hasn't been like anything we haven't experienced before, this is part of the NBA
quotes.quote: It has not been like anything we have not experienced before. This is part of the NBA, it is what it is. It is not like I do not feel any more drained or any more tired. I feel like it was more taxing than any other stretch of my career, so it is just part of the NBA, it is all in the season, but yeah, it is what it is.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the physical toll of the season: It is not like I do not feel any more drained or any more tired. It is just part of the NBA, it is all in the season.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander discusses the physical toll of the NBA season and the team's current situation.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on team chemistry and communication
quotes.excerpt: before teammates we are brothers and friends, so we knew that that was never going to leave
quotes.quote: Before teammates we are brothers and friends, so we knew that that was never going to leave us. It will be like that for us for our lives, and yeah, we having those guys around and still communicating is really good for us.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on team chemistry: Before teammates we are brothers and friends, so we knew that that was never going to leave us.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander speaks about the strong personal bond and communication among teammates.

quotes.speaker: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Bennett's played big-time basketball, he is a primary handler in his career
quotes.quote: Bennett's played big-time basketball. He is a primary handler in his career, and with guys out we are going to see him back in that role a little bit more. And he is more than capable and very comfortable doing so. He came out there aggressive, confident, he is obviously very skilled and smart out there, so he knows he knows where he needs to get. He knows his shots, he will continue to get better as his career goes on, but yeah, we will see him blossom more and more just with him having the ball in his hands and more his comfort zone.
quotes.social_post: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on Bennett's role: With guys out we are going to see him back in that role a little bit more. He is more than capable and very comfortable doing so.

structured.context: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander discusses Bennett taking on a larger role as a primary ball handler due to injuries.
